flagged.comment: Proposed trees near the overhead electric line are not differentiated by mature height or size on the Landscape Plan. Cannot verify whether large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 lateral feet of the distribution conductor.
areas: southern boundary where overhead electric line is present

flagged.comment: Utility poles are shown on the Landscape Plan (marked with 'x' symbols along the OHE line), and proposed trees are depicted throughout the plan. However, no clearance dimensions or measurements are provided between pole locations and tree locations. Cannot verify that all trees maintain the required 10-foot lateral clearance from poles.
areas: southern boundary where utility poles are marked

flagged.comment: Underground electric equipment (transformers and pull boxes) is shown on the Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21), but the relationship between these equipment locations and the proposed tree locations on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) is not clear. No clearance dimensions are shown between underground equipment and proposed trees.
areas: locations of underground transformers and pull boxes shown on Sheet 21

flagged.comment: The Landscape Plan does not indicate which proposed trees are within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, nor does it show root barrier specifications. Cannot verify required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) for trees within the 20-foot zone.
areas: locations within 20 lateral feet of underground equipment

flagged.comment: Proposed trees on the Landscape Plan that are located near the overhead electric line are identified only by the letter 'M' (Mitigation Tree) with no species names or common names provided on Sheet 31. The plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists proposed species but does not cross-reference their locations relative to utilities. Species identification is required on the Landscape Plan for trees near electric facilities to verify compliance with utility compatibility requirements.
areas: southern boundary where proposed trees are adjacent to overhead electric line

flagged.comment: Large trees proposed on the Landscape Plan are not differentiated from smaller trees by size, caliper, mature height, or any visual or textual designation. All mitigation and proposed trees are shown with the same symbol regardless of their mature height. Differentiation is required to allow reviewers to verify that large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) comply with clearance restrictions from overhead electric facilities.
areas: throughout the landscape plan, particularly trees proposed near overhead electric line

flagged.comment: No tree clearance measurements or dimensions are shown on the Landscape Plan between proposed trees and the overhead electric line. Therefore, the measurement methodology (whether measured from pole centerline vs. conductor, or from trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be assessed. This item is not verifiable due to absence of measurements rather than incorrect measurement methodology.

No tree clearance measurements are dimensioned on the Landscape Plan, so the measurement reference point (tree trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be evaluated. This checklist item cannot be verified due to the absence of measurements rather than incorrect methodology.

Without species identification for trees on the Landscape Plan and without clearance dimensions, it cannot be determined whether any proposed trees are within prohibited clearance zones. Therefore, the presence or absence of Austin Energy written approval for variations cannot be assessed. If trees are determined to be within restricted zones, such approval would be required and must be documented on the plans.
areas: southern boundary where trees may be within restricted clearance zones
